description: Apple Notes on macOS via a use.computer remote sandbox. Notes is preinstalled on macOS so install_apple_notes.sh only verifies /Applications/Notes.app is present. setup_apple_notes.sh writes baseline preferences via `defaults` and pre-creates the on-disk state dirs the agent and verifiers read from. Tasks cover note creation, folder organization, and content editing — verified via direct AppleScript queries against the Notes app (works over SSH because we tell the app directly, not System Events) and falling back to NoteStore.sqlite reads when needed.
